module elevator_controller (
    input clk, reset,
    input up_request, down_request,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

reg direction; // 0: idle, 1: moving up, 2: moving down

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        state <= 2'b00; // idle
        direction <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // idle
                if (up_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b01; // move up
                    direction <= 1'b1;
                end else if (down_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // move down
                    direction <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
            2'b01: begin // moving up
                if (up_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b01; // continue up
                end else if (down_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // switch to down
                    direction <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // no requests, go idle
                end
            end
            2'b10: begin // moving down
                if (down_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // continue down
                end else if (up_request) begin
                    state <= 2'b01; // switch to up
                    direction <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // no requests, go idle
                end
            end
            default: begin
                state <= 2'b00;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

module log2_int (
    input signed [15:0] in_0,
    output signed [7:0] out
);

reg [7:0] result;

always @(*) begin
    if (in_0 <= 0)
        result = 0;
    else if (in_0 >= 32768)
        result = 15;
    else begin
        result = 0;
        if (in_0 >= 16384) begin result = 14; end
        else if (in_0 >= 8192) begin result = 13; end
        else if (in_0 >= 4096) begin result = 12; end
        else if (in_0 >= 2048) begin result = 11; end
        else if (in_0 >= 1024) begin result = 10; end
        else if (in_0 >= 512) begin result = 9; end
        else if (in_0 >= 256) begin result = 8; end
        else if (in_0 >= 128) begin result = 7; end
        else if (in_0 >= 64) begin result = 6; end
        else if (in_0 >= 32) begin result = 5; end
        else if (in_0 >= 16) begin result = 4; end
        else if (in_0 >= 8) begin result = 3; end
        else if (in_0 >= 4) begin result = 2; end
        else if (in_0 >= 2) begin result = 1; end
        else begin result = 0; end
    end
end

assign out = result;

endmodule

module polynomial_1 (
    input signed [7:0] in_0,
    output signed [15:0] out
);

wire signed [15:0] term0, term1, term2, term3, term4, term5, term6, term7, term8, term9, term10, term11, term12, term13, term14, term15;

// Compute each term
assign term0  = 1 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // in_0^16
assign term1  = 2 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 2* in_0^15
assign term2  = 3 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 3* in_0^14
assign term3  = 4 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 4* in_0^13
assign term4  = 5 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 5* in_0^12
assign term5  = 6 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 6* in_0^11
assign term6  = 7 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 7* in_0^10
assign term7  = 8 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 8* in_0^9
assign term8  = 9 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 9* in_0^8
assign term9  = 10 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 10* in_0^7
assign term10 = 11 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 11* in_0^6
assign term11 = 12 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 12* in_0^5
assign term12 = 13 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0 * in_0; // 13* in_0^4
assign term13 = 14 * in_0 * in_0; // 14* in_0^3
assign term14 = 15 * in_0; // 15* in_0^2
assign term15 = 16; // constant term

// Sum all terms
assign out = term0 + term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9 + term10 + term11 + term12 + term13 + term14 + term15;

endmodule

    input [7:0] frequency,   // frequency in MHz
    output [7:0] wavelength  // wavelength in meters
);

assign wavelength = temp >> 8; // divide by 256 to get the approximate wavelength

endmodule
